question: What did you find that you were never supposed to see?
story: My mom has a secret Facebook account, and she uses it to catfish my dad. I found it by accident on the family iPad. An account named Sandra, fifty-two, loves fishing and classic rock. And Sandra had one conversation open. With my father. My heart dropped. I thought I was watching my parents' marriage end in real time. So I scrolled up, ready to be sick. And that's when I saw my dad's replies. Things like, sorry Sandra, I'm a happily married man. And, my wife makes the best lasagna in the state, she's the love of my life. She had been testing him for THREE YEARS. He passed every single time. I confronted my mom and she didn't even look up. She just said, thirty years of marriage and he's still worth checking on. They're insane. I hope I find it too.
